entries.label: Toilets
entries.description: Toilets travellers can use at the site.

osm.note: Maps the kind attribute value flush.
Maps the kind attribute value pit. Add composting=yes when the pit toilet composts.
Maps the kind attribute value chemical.
Maps the kind attribute value composting where the toilet dehydrates or composts waste.

entries.label: Showers
entries.description: Showers travellers can use at the site.

attributes.name: hot
attributes.description: True when hot water is available.

osm.note: Hot water available. Key:shower treats shower=hot as a tagging mistake.
Maps the fee attribute.

entries.label: Drinking water
entries.description: Water that travellers can drink or fill containers with. A safety fact.

attributes.name: potable
attributes.description: True when signed or known to be safe to drink without treatment.

attributes.name: treated
attributes.description: True when the supply is treated.

attributes.name: tank_fill
attributes.description: True when a hose or tap allows filling a vehicle's tank.

entries.label: Non-potable water
entries.description: Water for washing or flushing that is not safe to drink. A safety fact, so travellers know not to drink it.

attributes.name: signed_not_for_drinking
attributes.description: True when a sign says the water is not for drinking.

osm.note: On the tap or water point, for example man_made=water_tap.

entries.label: Power
entries.description: Mains power outlets for vehicles or campsites.

attributes.name: outlets
attributes.description: Number of outlets available to travellers.

attributes.name: metered
attributes.description: True when use is metered and charged by consumption.

attributes.name: outlet_type
attributes.description: The socket standard as written on the outlet.

entries.label: Dump point access
entries.description: A dump point at the site for toilet cassettes or waste water tanks.

attributes.name: drive_over
attributes.description: True when a vehicle can drive over it to empty a tank.

attributes.name: rinse_water
attributes.description: True when rinse water is provided.

attributes.name: guests_only
attributes.description: True when only paying guests may use it.

osm.note: Equivalent to guests_only true.

entries.label: Bins
entries.description: General waste bins.

osm.note: A bin is available at the camp site or caravan site.
Small bins, mapped as separate features.
Large bins or skips.

entries.label: Recycling
entries.description: Recycling bins or a recycling point.

entries.label: Barbecue
entries.description: A barbecue travellers can use.

osm.note: A barbecue mapped as a separate feature.

entries.label: Fire pit
entries.description: A fire ring or fireplace provided at the site. Whether fires may be lit is the separate fires_allowed facility.

osm.note: Key:fireplace is for chimneys and enclosed fireplaces, not fire pits.
A fire pit mapped as a separate feature.

entries.label: Fires allowed
entries.description: The site's standing policy allows campfires. Bans declared by fire authorities always override it and are not recorded in OTWD. A safety fact.

attributes.name: fire_rings_only
attributes.description: True when fires are allowed only in provided rings or pits.

attributes.name: seasonal_restrictions
attributes.description: Periods each year when the site itself does not allow fires.

entries.label: Shade
entries.description: Shade from trees or shelters over campsites or tables.

osm.note: Marks a feature that is in shade. Used mostly on ways and rare on camp sites.

entries.label: Picnic tables
entries.description: Picnic tables travellers can use.

osm.note: A picnic table is available at the camp site or caravan site.
Tables mapped as separate features.

entries.label: Playground
entries.description: A children's playground.

osm.note: Mapped as a separate feature.

entries.label: Swimming pool
entries.description: A swimming pool for guests.

attributes.name: heated
attributes.description: True when the pool is heated.

osm.note: A pool mapped as a separate feature.

entries.label: Laundry
entries.description: Washing machines or dryers travellers can use.

entries.label: Wi-Fi
entries.description: Wireless internet access provided by the site.

entries.label: Mobile coverage
entries.description: Mobile phone signal as contributors observed it on site, by carrier. These are observations, not carrier coverage maps.

attributes.name: observations
attributes.description: One entry per carrier observation: carrier, technology, signal (none, weak, fair, good), data_usable and observed_on.

entries.label: Pets allowed
entries.description: Pets may stay at the site, possibly with conditions. Read from the pets fact. pets.species gives the rule per species.

stored_as.rule: available is true when pets.allowed is yes, on_leash or by_arrangement, false when it is no.

osm.note: Documented on Key:pets as in use. pets=no when pets.allowed is no.
Dogs only. dog=leashed when the dog rule is on_leash. See pet-species.json for other species.

schema_org.note: petsAllowed is defined for LodgingBusiness (so Campground) and Accommodation, and takes a boolean or text, so species and conditions can go in the text. RVPark is not a LodgingBusiness, so use amenityFeature there.

entries.label: Dog off-leash area
entries.description: An area where dogs may run off the leash. Read from the pets fact.

osm.note: Dogs may be off the lead. Documented on Key:dog.

entries.label: Accessible facilities
entries.description: Facilities a wheelchair user can reach and use, with or without help. Read from the accessibility fact.

attributes.name: wheelchair
attributes.description: yes when arrival is yes and every recorded wheelchair feature is yes, limited otherwise. Absent when available is false.

attributes.name: features
attributes.description: The wheelchair features whose access is yes.

stored_as.rule: Absent with no wheelchair feature recorded. available false, no attributes: arrival is no or every recorded feature is no. Else wheelchair yes when arrival and every recorded feature are yes, limited otherwise (also when arrival is unknown). features: those that are yes.

osm.note: When the wheelchair attribute is yes.
When the wheelchair attribute is limited.
When available is false: arrival is no or every recorded feature is no.
When toilets is in features. Approved on the OSM wiki.
The count in accessibility.accessible_parking_spaces.
The key scheme in accessibility.toilets.key_scheme. See key-schemes.json.
When accessibility.toilets.changing_places is true. An adult change table alone is not a Changing Places toilet.
The accessibility notes.

entries.label: Generators allowed
entries.description: Travellers may run generators, possibly at set times.

attributes.name: designated_area_only
attributes.description: True when generators are allowed only in a set area.

entries.label: Big rig access
entries.description: The site suits big rigs. Read from rig_limits.big_rig_suitable. A safety fact.

stored_as.rule: available is true when rig_limits.big_rig_suitable is yes or limited, false when it is no.

osm.note: Length limits on the access road, not a property of the site.
Height limits on the access road, not a property of the site.
Weight limits on the access road, not a property of the site.

entries.label: Drive-through pitches
entries.description: Pitches a rig can drive into and out of without reversing.

entries.label: Ensuite pitches
entries.description: Pitches with a private bathroom.

entries.label: Cabins
entries.description: Cabins or units available to rent.

entries.label: Tent pitches
entries.description: Pitches where tents are allowed.

entries.label: Camp kitchen
entries.description: A shared kitchen for campers.
